{{Quote|One with the Force, they are, and our job it is to remember that we will, in time, also pass on. Luminous beings are we, but temporary vessels, our bodies are. And we shall all find ourselves here, in time. A moment of silence, I ask&mdash;to remember, and to move on.|Master Yoda|<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref>}}
In [[20 BBY/Legends|19.1 BBY]], a '''funeral''' was held for the six [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] who had perished in the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing of the Jedi Temple Hangar]]. One of the victims was [[Tutso Mara/Legends|Tutso Mara]]. The funeral was attended by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|senators]], and members of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] delivered a eulogy for the fallen Jedi.
